# foundry_vector_store (Resource)

Manages a vector store, which indexes attached files for retrieval by agents.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "foundry_vector_store" "support" {
  name = "support-knowledge-base"
  metadata = {
    team = "support"
  }
  expires_after_days = 30
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `expires_after_days` (Number) Number of days after the store is last active before it expires. Leave unset to keep the store indefinitely. Changing this forces a new vector store to be created.
- `metadata` (Map of String) Key-value metadata attached to the vector store. Changing this forces a new vector store to be created.
- `name` (String) Name of the vector store. Changing this forces a new vector store to be created.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (Number) Unix timestamp when the vector store was created.
- `file_count` (Number) Number of files attached to the vector store.
- `id` (String) Service-assigned vector store identifier.
- `status` (String) Processing status of the vector store.
- `usage_bytes` (Number) Total bytes used by the files in the vector store.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Vector stores are imported using the vector store ID.
terraform import foundry_vector_store.support vs_abc123
```
